answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring a unique crystal-lattice commitment: each identity mines a hash puzzle seeded from its unshared action history before any post. Peers verify via a lotus-ring of three random validators who recompute the lattice. A falcon-speed attacker creating N fakes pays O(N * puzzle_difficulty) compute with no amortization, since histories cannot be cloned, and failed lotus checks slash the attempt bond proportionally.
